pr_title: planner: don't handle collation in `in expression` if it contains a row function.
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: wjhuang2016 <huangwenjun1997@gmail.com>

<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #31273 and close #31300

Problem Summary:
It's vary hard to derive and set the best collation for `in expression` if it contains a row function.
For example: ("a", ("c", ("d", "e"))) in ("a", ("c"  collate bin, ("d", "e" collate general)))
We don't have a good idea to set the collation. So We decide that we don't handle collation in `in expression` if it contains a row function.


### What is changed and how it works?
Don't handle collation in `in expression` if it contains a row function.
If' acceptable and users rarely depend on it.

issue_context.title: The results of InStatement and EqualStatement are inconsistent
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
```
use test;
drop table if exists t;
create table t(`COL2` tinyint(16) DEFAULT NULL);
insert into t values(0);
select * from t WHERE COL2 IN (0xfc);
select * from t WHERE COL2 = 0xfc;
```
### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
mysql> select * from t WHERE COL2 IN (0xfc);
Empty set (0.00 sec)

mysql> select * from t WHERE COL2 = 0xfc;
Empty set (0.00 sec)
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```
mysql> select * from t WHERE COL2 IN (0xfc);
+------+
| COL2 |
+------+
|    0 |
+------+
1 row in set, 2 warnings (0.00 sec)

mysql> select * from t WHERE COL2 = 0xfc;
Empty set (0.00 sec)
```
